item.tib: lha rgod rgyud 'debs yid bzhin nor bu
item.coloph: ces khro rgyal lha rgod thog pa'i snyan rgyud kyi gsol 'debs rgyud phyag dbyer med yid bzhin nor bu 'di yang dbra btsun shes rab dgongs rgyal gyis/ bkra shis sman ri'i bla brang du nyams len thun mtshams su sbyar ba'o/ gter rgyud gsol 'debs spyi spungs skor gsum dang mthun la/ 'dir logs su ma (mi) dgos lags kyis/ 'on kyang mkhas rnams dgongs dpyad zhu//
